{{Quote|What's new on the NewsNets, Gabby?''"<br />"''Oh, not much really. Snowmen crashing parties on freedom-loving worlds everywhere, a tariff increase on Brentaal has put imports in the can, bad year for hemmel crops on Delle II, and would you believe Serra Hailey is trying to revive her holo career?|Danna and Gabriel|<ref name="Journal3" />}}
'''Delle II''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Journal3" /> located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Delle system/Legends|Delle system]], which contained massive [[Agriworld/Legends|farm worlds]]. It was situated between the [[Neuvia system/Legends|Neuvia]] and [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa systems]] and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir system]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which served as the dividing line between the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the type of [[Plant/Legends|crop]] known as [[Hemmel/Legends|hemmel]] was grown on Delle II. At one point, hemmel [[Farm/Legends|farming]] experienced a bad [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a fact that was reported on a [[NewsNet]] network and eventually mentioned by the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Gabriel]] to her partner, [[Danna]].<ref name="Journal3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Delle II was mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 3|third issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine, which was published in [[August]] [[1994]]. The feature was authored by [[Paul Sudlow]].<ref name="Journal3" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Delle [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Delle II, in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
